parameters.name: Category
parameters.description:
The service category. Valid values:

*   **standard**: Redis Open-Source Edition
*   **enterprise**: Tair (Enterprise Edition)

parameters.name: ParameterGroupDesc
parameters.description: The description of the parameter template. The description must be 0 to 200 characters in length.

parameters.name: ParameterGroupName
parameters.description:
The new name of the parameter template. The name must meet the following requirements:

*   The name can contain letters, digits, and underscores (\_). It must start with a letter and cannot contain Chinese characters.
*   The name can be 8 to 64 characters in length.

parameters.name: Parameters
parameters.description:
A JSON-formatted object that specifies the parameter-value pairs. Format: {"Parameter 1":"Value 1","Parameter 2":"Value 2"...}. The specified value overwrites the original content.

>  The parameters that can be added for different editions are displayed in the console.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun r-kvstore modify-parameter-group --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --category enterprise --parameter-group-id sys-0010000 --parameter-group-desc test --parameter-group-name testGroupName --parameters hz_:_12 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun r-kvstore ModifyParameterGroup --region cn-hangzhou --Category enterprise --ParameterGroupId 'sys-0010000' --Parameters 'hz_:_12' --ParameterGroupName testGroupName --ParameterGroupDesc test --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
